en.explanation:
According to the reaction

P4 + NaOH + 3H2O PH3 + 3NaH2PO2

oxidation state of phosphorus in P4 is zero while in PH3 it is 3 and in NaH2PO2, it is +1. This shows that this is a type of disproportionation reaction because there is an increase as well as decrease in the oxidation state of phosphorus.

The electronic configuration of Xe is 5s2 5p6; and that of Xe in excited state is 5s2 5p5 5d1. The hybridisation is sp3d and geometry is see-saw. The actual shape is trigonal bipyramidal but due to the preaence of lone pair it gets distorted to see-saw structure.
